This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Agee]]. She visited the anteroom of [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], but quickly left after the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] made a shrill sound in response to something his counterpart [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] was about to say.<ref name="TNR">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref>
